# Project: Build a web app that tracks daily water intake and sends reminders to help users meet their hydration goals.
<!-- Generated by handover v0.2.0 from claude chat on 2026-04-06T05:10:15.494719Z -->

## Tech Stack
- Language: Python (backend) / JavaScript (frontend)
- Framework: FastAPI + React + Vite + Tailwind CSS
- Database: SQLite

## Key Decisions
- React with Vite (rationale: Local-friendly setup with fast dev experience)
- FastAPI (Python) (rationale: Simple, fast, and easy to run locally)
- SQLite to start (rationale: Easy local setup with option to swap to Postgres later)
- Tailwind CSS (rationale: Utility-first styling, quick to build UI components)
- Recharts or Chart.js (rationale: Simple integration for bar charts showing daily intake history)
- Browser Notification API with setInterval, or service worker for background support (rationale: Web-native approach; backend web-push via web-push library as a more robust alternative)
- JWT auth (rationale: Simple and stateless, suitable for a local webapp)

## Constraints
- Must run locally with a local coding agent
- Use SQLite as the initial database


## Open Questions
- [ ] Should the backend use FastAPI (Python) or Express (Node)?
- [ ] Should reminders use a simple browser setInterval, a service worker, or a backend cron job with web push?
